iconography.brand: Exact supplied JPG retained as Resources/AppIcon.jpg; deterministic PNG and ICNS conversion; original PNG retained for provenance

numeric_unit_formatting.size: ByteCountFormatter for measured logical bytes with explicit size basis. Plugin grouped totals require every installation measured; Partial/Unknown groups disclose qualified known subtotals. Failed library measurement says Size unavailable with a scan issue; only a unique whole installation folder is a complete product total. Patch storage is Shared with library and techniques have no independent size.
numeric_unit_formatting.recency: project modification date proxy; samples only
numeric_unit_formatting.installer_record: Plugin installer history appears in inspector/per-format details, independent of Date added and Last used.
numeric_unit_formatting.addition_bounds: Qualified original-addition evidence takes precedence over exact Finder file-location Date Added metadata. Native Date Added is a location date, not an installation claim. Scan, birth, modification, receipt, and use dates never substitute. Unknown dates sort last; instruments never inherit library/player dates and techniques have no independent date.

patterns: Persistent category navigation; collection-specific evidence columns
Local interactive setup with draft/cancel semantics and explicit first scan
Full selectable paths and per-format Finder actions live in Location; tags and lifecycle facts lead the inspector
No numeric cleanup/savings claims from incomplete evidence
Table text is centered vertically inside 38pt rows with 8pt horizontal inset.

First-run setup moves Sample Libraries → Individual Sounds → Projects → Review & Scan within one native sheet; Back retains draft and Cancel discards it. Standard system plugins are automatic; legacy plugin roots remain removable but cannot be newly added. Scanning is local and read-only. Settings uses a flat Type/Folder editor.
Stream inventory before project analysis; pending references remain explicit. Determinate progress has no animation lag.
Native outline uses 16pt indentation with the shared 38pt row and 8pt text inset.
Search keeps matching patch ancestors; flat sample results show a root-relative breadcrumb and distinguish equal root names.
Measured library logical size is sortable globally with a source-specific basis; failed measurement says Size unavailable and instrument storage is Shared with library.
Tag dropdowns and Last used occupy separate rows. Unknown usage is not inactivity; unavailable age ranges remain disabled.
Settings appearance uses native popup Light/Dark/Match system preference; Light default, live preview, Cancel rollback, atomic Save without scan; app-wide semantic colors.

Check For Updates checks all configured roots from every tab and becomes Stop during work; plugin formats form the name subtitle with no duplicate format column; standard plugin roots automatic; one Settings entry for preferences.
